text: In 1937 the London music critic Rick Fitzgerald and his sister Pamela buy Windward House, [an abandoned seaside home in Cornwall|trigger|making a new home], for an unusually low price. A chill fills the unlocked studio, an unseen woman sobs before dawn, and the dog flees for good. Young Stella Meredith, whose mother fell from the nearby cliff seventeen years earlier, feels a calming presence there, until a séance reveals [a ghost that claims to guard her|threat|the restless dead] and an [old affair|wrong|love betrayed] draws her toward [the crumbling cliff|images|wild and lonely places].
